# Legitimate text that the Done check flags anyway. SKILL.md lists these as
# known false positives to ignore by eye, and test/done-check.sh checks that
# each line is quoted there word for word and is still flagged. If the pattern
# stops flagging one, move the line to must-pass.txt and update SKILL.md.
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
